name: Ampère Excellence Scholarship (ENS de Lyon)
requiredDocuments: Certificate of diplomas and degrees already obtained (e.g. Bachelor degree) — in French or English only; otherwise an officially certified French/English translation
University academic transcript of records — in French or English only; otherwise an officially certified French/English translation
Proof of enrollment for the current year (in French or English)
Program-specific additional documents where required (e.g. research project, language certificates, letters of recommendation); if a document is unavailable, a PDF explanation is expected

timeline.notes: Dates are the official 2026-2027 calendar from the ENS de Lyon application page; as of 2026-06 this cycle is already CLOSED ('Call for application 2026-2027 is now closed'). The 2027-2028 calendar is stated to be updated in November 2026. The 2025-2026 call previously ran 12 Nov 2024 – 31 Jan 2025. Deadline time is 11:59pm CET.

benefits: Ampère Scholarship of Excellence: €1,000 per month for 12 months (one academic year), renewable under conditions
Eligible for all ENS de Lyon Master's programs (Exact Sciences, Arts, Human & Social Sciences), except FEADéP and a few excluded master's programs
Paid in three installments: end of October (4 months), end of February (4 months), end of May (4 months)
Related GRADUATE+ Scholarship (separate award, SFRI-funded): €1,000/month for 10 months for selected Graduate initiatives (CORE, DynLifeSys, MathInfi, PACE) in M1 or M2
mustKnow: Living stipend only — €1,000/month is a merit grant; the official sources do NOT state that tuition, travel, insurance, or accommodation are covered. It is not a comprehensive tuition+stipend package.
One application form covers BOTH the Master's admission and the scholarship — there is no separate scholarship application; awards are decided by the ENS de Lyon admission committee.
Route by status: a Bangladeshi applies as a 'non-European student with a higher education degree in a foreign country'. Applying on the wrong form means the application is not considered.
Awarded for one predetermined Master's program for an initial 12 months; renewable under conditions (e.g. into the second master's year) but renewal is not automatic.

Strict obligations while funded: must complete full registration and submit proof before 20 September, sign attendance sheets (1st Tuesday of October, December, February and May), attend all classes/exams, sit resit sessions; failure or unjustified absence stops the stipend AND can trigger repayment of sums already received.

Mobility restrictions: scholarship holders must NOT do a study/research period abroad and must NOT do an internship in a lab not affiliated to ENS de Lyon; internships in the student's own country of origin are never authorized.

Language: certificates of English and/or French level are required depending on the discipline/level; waived if you studied entirely in a French- or English-speaking country (attach a self-written explanation).
As of 2026-06 the 2026-2027 cycle is CLOSED (deadline was 23 Jan 2026); the 2027-2028 calendar is due to be published in November 2026.
No age limit is stated anywhere in the official ENS de Lyon Ampère rules or application pages (any '≤26 / born after 1 January' figure could not be verified and is omitted).

universities: École Normale Supérieure de Lyon (ENS de Lyon)

duration: 1 academic year initially (12 months), renewable under conditions for the second master's year
eligibleNationalities: Open to international students with no country exclusions. Bangladeshi nationals are eligible and apply via the 'non-European student with a higher education degree in a foreign country' route. (European = EEA/EU + Norway/Iceland/Liechtenstein/Switzerland/Monaco/Andorra nationals; everyone else, including Bangladesh, is non-European.)
languageRequirements: Certificate of English and/or French level required depending on discipline and study level (per ENS de Lyon reference grids). Exception/waiver if you studied in a French- or English-speaking country or your studies were made entirely in French or English — attach a self-written explanation.
bondObligation: None (no return-home service bond); however, while funded the holder must not study/research abroad or intern outside ENS de Lyon-affiliated labs, and never in their country of origin
renewalConditions: Initial 12 months; renewable under conditions. Continued payment requires full registration, attendance (signed attendance sheets in Oct/Dec/Feb/May), sitting all exams (including resits), and compliance with the Ampère rules and ENS de Lyon internal regulations; breaches stop the stipend and may require repayment.
